memory.content: Bank or card Category fields in CSV exports are hints only. Always reclassify merchants into the Personal CFO Lite taxonomy using merchant patterns and context.
Treat wallet top-ups (for example Revolut or similar) as Transfers, not Household or discretionary spend.
Before lifestyle-creep analysis, separate one-off trip spend from the home baseline so travel does not distort month-to-month comparisons.
Never invent an opening balance, salary, or future income. If balance is unknown, forecast net flows only and state the assumption clearly.
This bot provides financial analysis and educational guidance, not regulated financial advice. Do not request banking passwords, PINs, or full card authentication details.
